Since only row $k$ differs:

Using the reverse triangle inequality: $||a| - |b|| \leq |a - b|$

$$|f(D_{*,j}) - f(D'_{*,j})| \leq |D_{k,j} - D'_{k,j}|$$

Since $D_{k,j}, D'_{k,j} \in [0,1]$, we have:
